newsitem.title: USA: D.H. Marketing sees Q2 EPS at $0.32.
newsitem.headline: D.H. Marketing sees Q2 EPS at $0.32.

text.p: D.H. Marketing & Consulting Inc on Thursday said it revised its second-quarter pretax earnings estimate to $0.32 per share.

The company in April said it would earn "at least $0.30 per share and current activities seem to indicate the balance of the year will continue to be just as strong," said David D. Hagen, the company's president and chief executive.
Hagen said the revised estimate on Thursday reflected the strong activity. The company makes electronic and electromechanical devices.
